In the first half of the NFL game between Broncos and Chargers, scheduled for October 11 at 4:05 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Chargers score 7 or more points in the first half.

If the Chargers score less than 7 points in the first half, this market will resolve to "Under".
